title: Amphitrite Point Lighthouse

terrainReference.basis: Original approach-footway point outside the building sets a fixed approximate dry rocky approach datum before terrain acquisition. Do not use the15mseamark focal elevation as structural height.

note: Exact named D-shaped lighthouse/service building with red lantern on its signed original plan. Original attached footway fixes the landward doorway and off-body approach datum. Local rocky foundation/step attachment approximate; detached station/helipads, fence, trail and landscape excluded.
